questions.question: In which year between 2010 and 2022 was the total college enrollment rate for recent high school graduates at its highest?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_college_enrollment_recent_graduates.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 302.10', header=None)
data = []
for idx, row in df.iterrows():
    val = str(row[0]).strip()
    if val.isdigit() and 2010 <= int(val) <= 2022:
        data.append((val, float(row[7])))
data.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
result = data[0][0]
questions.check_program:
import pandas as pd

data = df[pd.to_numeric(df[0], errors='coerce').notnull()].copy()
data[0] = data[0].astype(int)
subset = data[(data[0] >= 2010) & (data[0] <= 2022)].copy()
# Column H is index 7 (Total percent enrolled in college)
subset[7] = pd.to_numeric(subset[7])
best_year = subset.loc[subset[7].idxmax(), 0]
result = str(int(best_year))

questions.question: What was the average number of male recent high school completers, in thousands, from 1960 to 1962?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_college_enrollment_recent_graduates.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 302.10', header=None)
vals = []
for idx, row in df.iterrows():
    val = str(row[0]).strip()
    if val in ['1960', '1961', '1962']:
        vals.append(float(row[3]))
result = round(sum(vals) / len(vals))
